case_number: Civil Appeal No. 733 of 2023 (@SLP (C) No. 2478 of 2023)
summary: The appeal challenged the Delhi High Court's declaration that land acquisition lapsed under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013. The Supreme Court examined whether acquisition lapsed due to non-payment of compensation or non-possession. It held that possession was taken in 1964 and compensation deposited by 1967, satisfying due process. Relying on Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal, the Court ruled that Section 24(2) requires both non-possession and non-payment for lapse—mere non-payment or deposit delay does not cause lapse. The earlier reliance on Pune Municipal Corporation v. Solanki was overruled. The appeal was allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 24(2), Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal, (2020) 8 SCC 129
Pune Municipal Corporation v. Harakchand Misirimal Solanki, (2014) 3 SCC 183
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; acquisition not lapsed
